answers.core: I believe this requires modifying the editor's internal UI (script_editor_debugger.cpp). I don't think the Errors tab is exposed to add-ons or scripts—there's no API to change its font or theming from outside the engine. Related proposal: [#12904](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12904) requests monospace for the expression evaluator in the Debugger. This proposal addresses the same inconsistency in a different part of the Debugger panel.
answers.workaround:
**No practical workaround exists.**
- As far as I can tell, the Errors tab UI is internal to the editor and cannot be modified by add-ons
- Outputting to the Output panel instead works visually, but users don't see it because the Debugger panel auto-opens on errors
- Stripping the diagnostic formatting and outputting plain text loses the visual context that makes these errors useful

title: Use monospace font in Debugger → Errors tab for proper diagnostic alignment
